summary: Two demonstrated source-contract failures: q-73149 cannot replay because a distractor includes an already-zero entry; all generated prompts add unsupported global minimization. Mathematics, native grading, rendering and packaging passed bounded tests. Package unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Select the offered set of entries to replace by zero so the resulting ordinary matrix is in row echelon form.
reasoning_steps: Identify row-leading nonzero positions and zero rows.
Apply each candidate replacement set, recomputing leading positions or newly zero rows.
Reject equal/decreasing leading columns and internal zero rows.
Choose the offered set producing row echelon form and explain the transformed matrix.
invariants: Only entry replacement by zero; no Gaussian elimination or row swaps.
Row echelon means zero rows at bottom and strictly rightward leading entries; unit pivots are not required.
A single correct offered operation; every offered distractor must fail the actual row-echelon test.
Prompt, coordinate bank, transformed matrix and solution must depend on the same instance.
permitted_variations: Nonzero magnitudes and signs are irrelevant to echelon status and may vary.
Zero/nonzero structure, pivot destinations, preexisting/became-zero rows and specific correct coordinates may vary within the same 4 by 4 workload.
Eligible correct sets, offered distractor profiles, and option positions should vary; original masks and source-specific correct coordinates are incidental assignments, not definitions of the skill.

source_replay.details: All 15 original banks independently have exactly the stored valid option. Generator rejects q-73149; 14 others accepted only with changed prompt/solution contract. Canonical answer bank absent from source; its stated transformation checks correctly.

math.details: Independent exact integer enumeration verified 32 fresh seeds 702311..702342 and exact 5-record batch: all offered keys, unique minima, and transformed matrices correct. This does not justify added minimization scope.

variety.details: 108 target roles across 747 catalogue masks provide real zero-structure variation; 32 samples contain 28 answer sets. Nevertheless complete source bank profiles and legitimate same-method nonminimum offered operations are suppressed by validation. Exact batch has 5 answer sets, 2- and 3-entry answers, and no newly zeroed rows; this concentration alone is not treated as a defect.

scope.details: Source requires recognizing which offered erasure yields REF. The fewest-replacements prompt and global-minimum validation add an optimization requirement absent from the lesson and every captured source prompt.

grading.details: Actual native grader: 17 independently verified right selections accepted and 68 wrong selections rejected, including all five normalized delivered records and both counterfactual types. Radio-only response contract: free-entry equivalents do not apply.

rendering.details: Actual UI reports pass for all 5 normalized batch records and 3 counterfactual records; representative screenshots visually inspected. No mathematical display, font, image or JavaScript errors reported.

packaging.details: Python exactly 3.13.5 matches manifest; packages is an empty object and imports are standard-library/local only. Deterministic replay, relocation under evidence, positive count validation and difficulty rejection verified; package file hashes unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Relevant and irrelevant dependencies pass actual grading/render checks, and tested surface probes do not establish a learner-visible deterministic shortcut. The specification fixes global-minimum status without source justification and rejects eligible banks. Actual publication filter retains 32/32 independent and 5/5 batch records; captured selection rules examined, but future entity IDs, weights and learner history are unavailable. Five stored optimization prompts observed; their exact current-generator identity replay failed, so affected-inventory.json is not evidence of absence.

findings.description: Complete source q-73149 is rejected solely because distractor {a21,a31} includes a21=0. Replacing an already-zero entry is well-defined and that offered set remains wrong; the stored correct {a31,a42} uniquely succeeds. The validator suppresses a genuine source bank profile.

findings.requested_change: Allow distinct in-range zero-valued coordinates in offered distractors; evaluate every offered erasure against the REF rule and require exactly one successful option. Restore full q-73149 source-bank replay rather than dropping its distractor.

findings.description: The family changes recognition of an offered REF-producing operation into globally minimizing the number of erasures. Every batch prompt adds using the fewest replacements, and a valid same-method operation is rejected even when it is the sole successful option. This is a specification change, independent of item arithmetic.

findings.requested_change: Restore the source operation-selection wording and derive correctness from which offered sets yield REF. Remove the family-wide unique-global-minimum admission rule; retain unique correctness within each five-choice bank. Keep the strict failing tests and exercise corrected bank construction without adding optimization workload.
